title: Haunted House
description: Three friends enter a haunted house, where VixVoxWave turns a skeptical phrase into a perfectly timed ghostly prank. Read Story 1.
dek: Three friends, one old house, and a skeptical phrase waiting for exactly the wrong quiet moment.
contentNote: Mild spooky imagery and a jump-scare reaction.
shortAlt: Eight-panel comic: three friends use VixVoxWave for a ghost prank in an old house.
summary: On a stormy night, three friends explore an old house. One of them dismisses the idea of ghosts, so another starts VixVoxWave and lets the silence do the rest.
bodyParagraphs: A storm turns an abandoned-looking house into the perfect setting for a dare. Inside, one friend insists that ghosts are not real while another quietly starts VixVoxWave.
The hallway falls silent. The app captures the skeptical phrase and plays it back in a creepy voice at just the right moment. The group screams, realizes the trick, and dissolves into laughter.
longDescription: On a stormy night, three friends approach a tall, weathered old house lit by lightning. Inside, one friend dismisses ghosts while another challenges him. The friend in a green hoodie starts VixVoxWave on his phone. As the group waits in a dark hallway lined with portraits, the app captures “Ghosts aren’t real,” detects a silent gap, and repeats the phrase in a ghostly voice surrounded by purple mist. All three scream, then laugh when they realize it was a prank. The final panel shows the phone reporting “Laughter detected” and calls VixVoxWave the ultimate ghost prank app.

panels.heading: The dare
panels.visualDescription: Three friends stand in the rain before a tall, dark old house while lightning forks across the sky.

transcript.text: A stormy night. An old house. Three friends.
This place is definitely haunted. No way.

panels.heading: Inside
panels.visualDescription: The friends stand together in a dusty room. One smiles at a phone while the others trade skeptical looks.

transcript.text: Ghosts aren’t real. It’s just an old house. Relax.

panels.heading: Listening
panels.visualDescription: The friend in a green hoodie holds up a phone showing VixVoxWave in a listening state.

transcript.text: The app listens. Finds the right moment.

panels.heading: The gap
panels.visualDescription: An empty, dim hallway stretches toward a closed door beneath a single hanging light.

transcript.text: It waits for silence. The perfect gap.

panels.heading: Captured
panels.visualDescription: One friend looks uneasy beside an illustrated app display showing a captured phrase and a detected silence.

transcript.text: Phrase captured. “Ghosts aren’t real.” Analyzing… Silence detected.

panels.heading: The answer
panels.visualDescription: Purple mist curls through the dark hallway around a pale speech balloon.

panels.heading: The scare
panels.visualDescription: All three friends recoil with wide eyes and startled expressions against a purple burst.

panels.heading: The reveal
panels.visualDescription: The three friends laugh together around the phone after realizing the ghostly voice was a prank.

transcript.text: VixVoxWave: the ultimate ghost prank app.

disclosure: This fictional comic is a playful dramatization. Its illustrated screen and detection events are not a literal walkthrough of the current app and are not a promise of specific detection behavior.
